<?php
/**
 * ML Inference Server with Role-Based Access Control
 * Handles model inference requests with temporary file management
 */

class SecurityContext {
    private string $userId;
    private string $role;
    private string $sessionToken;
    
    public function __construct(string $userId, string $role, string $sessionToken) {
        $this->userId = $userId;
        $this->role = $role;
        $this->sessionToken = $sessionToken;
    }
    
    public function getUserId(): string { return $this->userId; }
    public function getRole(): string { return $this->role; }
    
    public function hasPermission(string $action): bool {
        $permissions = [
            'admin' => ['infer', 'train', 'deploy', 'manage_users'],
            'data_scientist' => ['infer', 'train'],
            'analyst' => ['infer'],
        ];
        return in_array($action, $permissions[$this->role] ?? [], true);
    }
}

/**
 * Validates session tokens and resolves the authenticated identity/role
 * from a trusted server-side source instead of the client request body.
 */
class SessionAuthenticator {
    private array $sessions;

    public function __construct(array $sessions) {
        // In production this would query a secure session store / auth service.
        $this->sessions = $sessions;
    }

    public function authenticate(string $sessionToken): ?SecurityContext {
        if ($sessionToken === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $session = null;
        // Constant-time lookup to avoid leaking token existence via timing.
        foreach ($this->sessions as $storedToken => $info) {
            if (hash_equals((string) $storedToken, $sessionToken)) {
                $session = $info;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($session === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return new SecurityContext(
            $session['user_id'],
            $session['role'],
            $sessionToken
        );
    }
}

class ModelRegistry {
    private array $models = [];
    
    public function register(string $name, string $path, string $version): void {
        $this->models[$name] = ['path' => $path, 'version' => $version];
    }
    
    public function getModel(string $name): ?array {
        return $this->models[$name] ?? null;
    }
}

class InferenceWorkspace {
    private string $baseDir;
    private array $activeFiles = [];
    
    public function __construct(string $baseDir) {
        $this->baseDir = rtrim($baseDir, '/');
        if (!is_dir($this->baseDir)) {
            mkdir($this->baseDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates a workspace file for inference data staging.
     * Uses PHP's tempnam for atomic file creation with kernel-level guarantees.
     */
    public function createWorkspaceFile(string $userId, string $modelName, string $suffix = '.dat'): string {
        $prefix = sprintf('ml_%s_', substr(hash('sha256', $userId . $modelName), 0, 8));
        
        // tempnam atomically creates the file, preventing TOCTOU races
        $filepath = tempnam($this->baseDir, $prefix);
        if ($filepath === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to create secure temporary file');
        }
        
        // Rename to add suffix while maintaining security
        $finalPath = $filepath . $suffix;
        rename($filepath, $finalPath);
        chmod($finalPath, 0600);
        
        $this->activeFiles[] = $finalPath;
        return $finalPath;
    }
    
    public function cleanup(): void {
        foreach ($this->activeFiles as $file) {
            if (file_exists($file)) {
                unlink($file);
            }
        }
        $this->activeFiles = [];
    }
}

class InferenceEngine {
    private ModelRegistry $registry;
    private InferenceWorkspace $workspace;
    
    public function __construct(ModelRegistry $registry, InferenceWorkspace $workspace) {
        $this->registry = $registry;
        $this->workspace = $workspace;
    }
    
    public function runInference(SecurityContext $ctx, string $modelName, array $inputData): array {
        if (!$ctx->hasPermission('infer')) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied: insufficient permissions');
        }
        
        $model = $this->registry->getModel($modelName);
        if ($model === null) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Model not found: ' . $modelName);
        }
        
        // Stage input data to workspace
        $inputFile = $this->workspace->createWorkspaceFile(
            $ctx->getUserId(), $modelName, '.input.json'
        );
        $outputFile = $this->workspace->createWorkspaceFile(
            $ctx->getUserId(), $modelName, '.output.json'
        );
        
        try {
            file_put_contents($inputFile, json_encode($inputData, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
            
            // Simulate model inference
            $result = $this->executeModel($model, $inputFile, $outputFile);
            
            return $result;
        } finally {
            $this->workspace->cleanup();
        }
    }
    
    private function executeModel(array $model, string $inputFile, string $outputFile): array {
        // In production, this would call the actual ML runtime
        $inputData = json_decode(file_get_contents($inputFile), true);
        $prediction = array_map(fn($v) => $v * 0.5 + 0.1, $inputData['features'] ?? [0]);
        
        $result = ['predictions' => $prediction, 'model_version' => $model['version']];
        file_put_contents($outputFile, json_encode($result));
        
        return $result;
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
$registry = new ModelRegistry();
$registry->register('sentiment_v2', '/opt/models/sentiment/v2', '2.1.0');
$registry->register('classification_v1', '/opt/models/classify/v1', '1.3.2');

$workspace = new InferenceWorkspace('/tmp/ml_workspace');
$engine = new InferenceEngine($registry, $workspace);

// Trusted server-side session store (would be backed by a real store in production).
$authenticator = new SessionAuthenticator([
    // 'stored-session-token' => ['user_id' => '...', 'role' => 'analyst'],
]);

// Request handling
$requestBody = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if (!$requestBody) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request body']);
    exit;
}

// Authenticate using the session token; do NOT trust client-supplied role/user_id.
$ctx = $authenticator->authenticate($requestBody['token'] ?? '');
if ($ctx === null) {
    http_response_code(401);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Authentication required']);
    exit;
}

try {
    $result = $engine->runInference($ctx, $requestBody['model'] ?? '', $requestBody['data'] ?? []);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'success', 'result' => $result]);
} catch (\Throwable $e) {
    // Log the detailed error server-side; return a generic message to the client.
    error_log('Inference error: ' . $e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Request could not be completed']);
}
